newsitem.title: USA: Mallon Resources stake held by Cambridge.
newsitem.headline: Mallon Resources stake held by Cambridge.

text.p: A group led by Cambridge Investments Ltd and John Tozzi said Tuesday it holds a 10.7 percent stake in Mallon Resources Corp or 468,800 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought the stake between October 17 and December 9 at prices ranging from $6.50 to $8.50 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes, the filing said.
The Denver, Colo.,-based company is engaged in mineral and oil and gas exploration and production.
